Counts that can be checked.

The municipal profile gives one census snapshot and one land-area figure. The DTI CMCI adds a ten-year competitiveness rank series, with its own population field.

The CMCI population field conflicts with the municipal census figure. It is kept inside the CMCI section only.

Ten years of ranks.

The CMCI rank series follows the DTI profile for Ibaan. Ranks are shown as published; no overall score is added where the profile does not show one.

The 2024 pillars.

The 2024 profile records five pillars, each weighted at twenty percent. Ranks and scores below are CMCI-specific values.

Ibaan's 2024 CMCI pillar ranks and scores
Pillar Rank Score
Economic Dynamism 234th 3.3713
Government Efficiency 423rd 7.2961
Infrastructure 246th 2.4410
Resiliency 444th 10.8023
Innovation 281st 4.9024
